scope: author-controlled synthetic curriculum, not an external blind benchmark
timing: Reader results were already observed when this gate file was written; Writer/Planner candidate outputs were not. This is not a fully preregistered benchmark.
selection: each stage's lowest validation teacher-forcing loss, then actual-generation gates; no holdout tuning
reader_validation: improve over 56/64 with no increase above baseline 1 false positive
writer_validation: at least 6/8 fully correct, empty-evidence refusal required, no new failure on previously passing cases
planner_validation: all 8 plans structurally valid, all requested objects/dimensions preserved; manually check question scope
holdout: reader at least 60/64 with no false positives; writer at least 7/8 including empty-evidence refusal
end_to_end: at least 7/8 fully correct with no empty-evidence fabrication; execution success alone is insufficient
noncomparison_regression: check existing evidence-first Writer regression suite before any global Writer state replacement
promotion: no default activation unless applicable gates pass; keep original answers, candidates and failed trials
